newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-NICE REACH FINAL AGAINST GUINGAMP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NICE REACH FINAL AGAINST GUINGAMP.

text.p: Nice, bottom of the first division, reached their fourth French Cup Final when they beat second division Laval 1-0 on Sunday.
The Cote d'Azur side, who scored through Thierry de Neef in the 33rd minute, meet Guingamp in the final at Parc des Princes in Paris on May 10.
Guingamp beat fellow first division side Montpellier 2-0 after extra time in the other semifinal on Saturday to reach the final for the first time.

Nice belied their poor league defensive record -- 58 goals conceded in 33 matches -- to control Laval, playing in their second French Cup semifinal in four years, after being eliminated by the second division side last season.

They scored on the break as Laval were claiming a penalty at the other end, midfielder de Neef volleying Mohammed Chaouch's header past Laval goalkeeper Christophe Gardie for his third goal in the competition.
"We have plenty of merits and I hope people will recognise that we're not as bad as all that and don't deserve this 20th place in the championship," de Neef said.
"We've had a black season and we had to do something."
Laval threw everything into attack in the final minutes and nearly snatched an injury-time equaliser but midfielder Stephane Pichot's shot hit the post and was cleared off the Nice line.
Nice, twice French Cup winners in the 1950s, are now one step from a place in Europe next season while staring relegation in the face.
